children: Luc Jules R Tack disclosed a 20.0% stake in FMC Corporation through Tessenderlo Group NV. On September 23, 2026, Tessenderlo purchased 30,319,166 shares in a private placement at $13.30 per share, and the Schedule 13D was filed on September 25, 2026. The deal grants board representation, pre-emptive and top-up rights, and a long lock-up with standstill limits.

Tessenderlo won governance rights alongside its investment: the board expanded by one seat and the company "has the right to nominate one candidate for appointment and election as an independent director," with Luc Jules R Tack named to the seat and Miguel de Potter as a non-voting observer. Ownership-related limits apply: pre-emptive and top-up rights allow Tessenderlo to maintain its stake but cap ownership at 20%.

The agreement sets a lock-up on transfers until September 23, 2029, a standstill that restricts moves to gain control without board consent, and a voting pact to back the board’s nominees and recommendations, except on change-of-control matters. Tessenderlo also said it "intends to exercise its top-up rights to purchase additional Shares."

Tessenderlo Group NV is a Belgian public limited company that operates an industrials group with activities spanning agriculture and industrial solutions. The company is led by CEO Luc Jules R Tack, who controls Oostiep Group, the holding company for Tessenderlo. Tessenderlo typically pursues long-term industrial investments, focusing on operational improvements and disciplined capital allocation across its portfolio.
